data.narrative:
Swarm Aero is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies spanning the Defense & Security sector, including 2 public firms (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $8M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $20M. Peer-median analysis benchmarks against three same-sector, same-or-adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The median across these three peers is $400M, with a range of $125M to $1.0B. These two methods produce meaningfully different signals, reflecting uncertainty around both company maturity and the heterogeneity of defense-tech valuations at early stages.

The triangulated analysis yields a range of $17M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $210M. The wide spread—spanning nearly two orders of magnitude—reflects the substantial gap between stage-based and peer-median approaches. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set for an early-stage company and whether defense-sector comps, which span Seed through mature stages, appropriately anchor Swarm Aero's specific risk and growth profile.
